description: Create a new SRIFT secure session. Returns the 7-character session ID and a shareable URL. The host approves all future joins. E2EE keys derive locally from the session ID + optional roomSecret.

roomSecret.description: Optional shared secret mixed into key derivation. Never sent to server. Without it the key is derivable from the session ID (which the server sees); set it to make the key participant-only.

name: srift_start_session

url.description: Direct browser join URL to share with peers

title: Start SRIFT Session
